name: application-selects
title: Selects
description: Native dropdown select inputs for choosing a single option from a list, with option group and datalist variants.
useWhen: Users must choose exactly one value from a list too long to show as radio buttons.
Filtering a dataset by a single attribute such as status, country, or category.
Providing a settings or preference picker where all options fit in a compact list.
avoidWhen: There are only 2–3 options — radio buttons make all choices immediately visible.
Multi-selection is needed — use a multi-select or checkbox group instead.
The list is very long and users benefit from search or autocomplete — use a combobox.
responsiveBehavior: Select inputs fill their container width. Browser-native dropdowns inherit platform-appropriate mobile handling automatically.
accessibility: Every select must have an associated <label> linked by for/id or as a wrapping element.
Use <optgroup label='...'>  to group related options in longer lists.
The native <select> element provides built-in keyboard navigation (arrow keys and search-by-typing).

variants.title: Base
variants.description: Standard single-option native select input with a visible label for form fields and filters.
accessibility: Requires a linked <label>; native <select> keyboard navigation is built in.

variants.title: Base (Dark)
variants.description: Standard single-option native select adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark select background and text must meet WCAG AA contrast requirements.

variants.title: Option groups
variants.description: Select input with options organized into labeled <optgroup> sections for a structured, categorized list.
accessibility: <optgroup> labels are announced by screen readers when the user enters each group.

variants.title: Option groups (Dark)
variants.description: Grouped-option select input adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Option text colors within the browser-native dropdown may depend on the OS theme.

variants.title: Datalist
variants.description: Text input enhanced with a <datalist> for type-ahead suggestion of predefined options while still allowing free entry.
accessibility: Datalist suggestions are announced natively; the text input must still have a linked label.

variants.title: Datalist (Dark)
variants.description: Type-ahead datalist input adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Input text and border must meet WCAG AA contrast; datalist popup appearance depends on the browser.
